lesson-intro.text: Stand on any street corner and look up: the walls run away from you on both sides. This one has a little café downstairs. Watch it come together, then build one on your own block.

eye-line.text: Start with two short level lines, one on each side, at the height of your eyes.

corner.text: Next, the near corner: one tall upright line between them.

walls.text: Each wall runs back from the corner, its top tipping down and its foot tipping up.

top-band.text: Along the roofline, a cream band that turns the corner.

chimney.text: A small chimney sits on the band, its two faces meeting in a peak.

door.text: On the left wall, the door stands on the ground, with a window in it.

awning.text: On the right wall, the café awning. Five bumps along the bottom, four lines between the stripes.

cafe-window.text: Under it, the big café window, with two short lines for shine.

left-windows.text: Four windows up the left wall, two on each floor, leaning like the wall.

right-windows.text: Four more on the right wall. The far ones come out a little smaller.

ledges.text: A ledge under six of the windows, tilted like each window.

flower-boxes.text: The last two windows get a flower box instead, each with a bumpy bush on top.

yellow-orange.text: Color the left wall yellow and the right wall orange.

cream.text: Cream for the top band, the ledges and two stripes.

blue.text: Every window is blue, the café window and the door's pane too.

brown.text: Brown for the door, the flower boxes and one side of the chimney. One flower in each bush too.

red-green.text: Red for the chimney's front, three stripes and the tiny flowers. Green for both bushes.

lesson-outro.text: Your corner café is open. What's the first thing you'd order?
